name: Patrolling Westfall
label: Quest
description: Gnoll packs roam Westfall's grasslands, threatening the people who still live there. Captain Danuvin calls on volunteers from Sentinel Hill to hunt them…
intro: Gnoll packs roam Westfall's grasslands, threatening the people who still live there. Captain Danuvin calls on volunteers from Sentinel Hill to hunt them, fearing they work with the thieves in the Deadmines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stormwind has abandoned us. A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall. This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here. We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall. Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was. Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
